title: Anyone else get brain lag from overly-condensed AI-speak? [D]
summary: We’ve all had the experience of coming across a phrase like “quiet single-source substitute” which just barely makes sense in the context of the conversation but takes way too much effort to parse. What research exists into making AI more readable? I feel like this is a particula
reason: Reddit discussion question asking about readability research; no named model release, no research artifact/paper link, not an industry, policy, or OSS tool announcement. No rule covers it.
